_note: Declarative agent->sprint-step attachment registry (ADR-0007 / Phase D foundation). ONE row per attachment: which role fires at which lifecycle step, under what condition, advisory or blocking. `role` references .claude/agents/_org/role-registry.json by id. Adding/swapping an agent = editing a ROW, never the orchestrator (same proven pattern as _guides/registry.json). Consumed by scripts/sprint/hook-points.js (the composition->agent-set router) and the bidirectional scan:sprint-hook-coverage enforcer (forward: every matched row ran or logged debt; reverse: every dispatching role is registered, no step orphaned). Rows are the current-roster translation of sprint-hook-points-design.md sec.5 (which used pre-ADR-0007 names: product-designer->design-lead, DoQA->quality-lead, redteam->security-reviewer, qa+compliance->qa-reviewer).

phase_map._note: full.js PHASES are coarser than the lifecycle hook-points: build+gauntlet both occur inside full.js 'execute'; release maps to 'release-prep'. The runtime reconciles.

condition_forms.unit_type: { unit_type: [..] } — fires if the sprint composition includes ANY listed unit type (frontend|backend|security|ui)
condition_forms.risk_min: { risk_min: <low|medium|high|critical> } — fires if the sprint max risk class is >= the given level
condition_forms.domain: { domain: [..] } — fires if the composition includes ANY listed domain (marketing|copy)

modes.block: a matched row that does NOT run (or whose verdict FAILs) halts/blocks the step
modes.advisory: a matched row that does not run is a warning, not a halt (e.g. design-quality's W1 ramp)

_report_only: An OPTIONAL additive boolean field on a row (NOT a mode value — `mode` stays one of block|advisory so validate() passes). `report_only: true` is the explicit REPORT-ONLY contract: the row is COMPOSED into the step and RUNS, but its verdict can NEVER gate — strictly stronger than plain advisory, which only means 'a no-run is a warning'. A report_only row is always also mode:advisory (belt-and-suspenders: it cannot block even if a future edit flips its mode). The blocking flip (report_only:false + mode:block) is operator-gated. Surfaced by the resolver as agent.report_only so a consumer/test can assert REPORT-ONLY explicitly. SP-20260614-001 / AC-design: design-quality is wired report-only this sprint.
